meta.title: Dutch with "Offers on Best Price" requires a closing condition

args.title: Dutch Best Price Closing Condition Test

steps.note: Create an RFQ that can be converted to a Dutch auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the auction conversion create screen, where Dutch configuration is available.

args.goal: select the Dutch auction strategy, select “Offers on Best Price”, and leave the screen showing the closing-condition selector as required and unfilled

steps.note: Configure the unavailable Dutch setting on screen and verify that choosing Offers on Best Price exposes a required closing-condition selector.
Confirm the resulting configuration screen has no crash or error.
